s076.sec51.u0: Who the heck are you?! Nobody messes up this place on my watch!
s076.sec51.u1: No, we're traveling around to save the island...
s076.sec51.u2: You think I'll fall for a dumb lie like that? Take this!
s076.sec51.u4: Wait... are you telling the truth?
s076.sec51.u6: Heh, sorry. We hardly ever get strangers out here. First job in ages, so I got carried away.
s076.sec51.u8: Yep. I guard this place, the Ancient Dino Region, the most remote land on the island!
s076.sec51.u9: Huh... Then how about showing us around?
s076.sec51.u10: The Ancient Dino Region is split into two big parts. First, where we dinosaur Digimon live: the Glacial Region. It's a special place where time flows slower.
s076.sec51.u12: And the other one's the Speedy Region. It's a danger zone past the Glacial Region. What makes it dangerous? Time flows crazy fast there. So the land's all worn away, with bones and fossils lying everywhere.
s076.sec51.u13: Right, because more time has passed there than anywhere else.
s076.sec51.u14: Exactly. If you don't want to die, stay away from it. ...Not that I'd let you pass anyway, with me blocking the road.
s076.sec51.u15: But you lost to us just now.
s076.sec51.u16: Ugh... That was a fluke! It's not usually like that!
s076.sec51.u18: Um... W-well, I'd better get back to my post! Anyway, ask the Digimon around here about anything else. See ya!
